scripts.verificar: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.preparar:functions: npm run build:functions && npm --prefix functions install --no-audit --no-fund --no-package-lock && node flujo/emulador/secretos-falsos.mjs
scripts.emuladores: npm run preparar:functions && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-ribu
scripts.test:reglas: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-ribu "vitest run --config vitest.emulador.config.ts flujo/emulador/reglas"
scripts.test:flujo: npm run preparar:functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-ribu "vitest run --config vitest.emulador.config.ts flujo/emulador/flujo"
